dog.description_text:
Meet Lucy, an adorable two-year-old miniature poodle with a big personality and a whole lot of love to give!

Thanks to Hope4Fur and the Andrew Sabin Family Foundation, this little lady made an incredible journey all the way from China to New York to escape the Chinese meat trade and get her chance at the life every dog deserves. Now, Lucy is ready to trade her travel adventures for belly rubs, cozy naps, and a family to call her own.

Lucy has already traveled halfway around the world. Now she's hoping her next stop is HOME!
